meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

copy.tagline: 用 PostgreSQL 构建并部署 Firebase 数据后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Firebase 并需要关系型数据库和类型安全 SDK
copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy Firebase SQL backends with PostgreSQL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Firebase and need a relational database with type-safe SDKs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你搭建和部署 Firebase SQL Connect(Firebase 的关系型数据库)后端:设计表结构、编写带权限的查询/写入操作、配置实时数据更新,并生成类型安全的客户端 SDK。
howto.when: 当你说到 SQL Connect、Data Connect 等关键词,或要求设计表结构、编写查询/写入、配置实时更新时触发。

say.text: 给查询加权限,只允许登录用户读取自己的订单。
say.note: Claude 会在查询/写入文件里加 @auth 校验。

say.text: 配置实时订阅:当新电影插入时刷新列表。

howto.what_en: Builds/deploys Firebase SQL Connect (formerly Firebase Data Connect) backends on PostgreSQL: defines schema tables/relations, writes authorized queries/mutations, configures realtime refresh, generates type-safe SDKs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect, needs a relational database with Firebase, or asks to design schemas, write queries/mutations, configure realtime updates, or generate SDKs.

say_en.text: Create a PostgreSQL database in Firebase with user and post tables.
say_en.note: Claude initializes dataconnect and generates schema.

say_en.text: Add auth so logged-in users can only read their own orders.
Set up a realtime subscription to refresh a list when a movie is inserted.
